resources.string: Privacy Policy for PolyGo+ Last updated: August 03, 2026 PolyGo+ ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how your personal information is collected, used, and disclosed by PolyGo+. 1. Information We Collect To facilitate a secure campus marketplace, we collect information you provide when you register, including: - Name - Campus Email Address - Student Identification (for PKS verification) - Profile information 2. How We Use Your Information We use the information we collect to: - Verify your status as a student/staff through PKS (Pusat Komputer dan Sistem) verification. - Provide, operate, and maintain our marketplace. - Facilitate transactions between buyers and sellers. - Send you technical notices, updates, and support messages. 3. PKS Verification As a campus-exclusive marketplace, we verify user identity through the institution's PKS system. This ensures all users are valid members of the campus community. We do not store your PKS credentials; we only receive a confirmation of your status. 4. Sharing of Information We do not share your personal information with third parties except: - Between buyers and sellers to facilitate a transaction (e.g., contact information). - If required by law or to protect the rights of PolyGo+. 5. Data Security We use reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access. 6. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@poliku.com.

Terms of Service for PolyGo+ Last updated: August 28, 2026 PolyGo+ is a campus-only marketplace for Politeknik Kuching Sarawak (PKS) students and staff. 1. Eligibility You must have a valid PKS student or staff identity. Accounts may remain unverified until an admin approves your request. 2. Marketplace rules List only items you own. Prohibited goods, scams, and harassment are not allowed. Meet in public campus locations such as Block A or the cafeteria. 3. Transactions PolyGo+ helps you record offers, meetups and receipts. Payment is arranged between buyer and seller. Mark a deal complete only after the meetup succeeds. 4. Community moderation Use Report listing or Report user if you see prohibited items or suspicious behaviour. We may remove content and suspend accounts. 5. Contact Questions: support@poliku.com
